==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L169}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|emphasise||Australia|New Zealand|South Africa|UK}}

===Etymology===
{{uder|en|la|-}}, from {{uder|en|grc|-}} – see {{m|en|emphasis}}. {{surf|en|emphasis|-ize}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɛm.fə.saɪz/|[ˈɛɱ.fə.saɪz]|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vininn126-emphasize.wav|a=US}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[stress]], give [[emphasis]] or extra [[weight]] to (something).
#: {{ux|en|His two-fingered gesture '''emphasized''' what he had told his boss to do with his job.}}
